title: Budget-sensitive first-home couple
starting_message: Hi, I saw the ad. How much is this project?

buyer.hidden_profile: Own-stay couple with one young child; RM3xxk comfort, bank financing and low monthly commitment matter. Spouse is joint decision-maker.
buyer.hidden_motivation: Affordable first home with enough usable space for family.
buyer.hidden_objections: Worries 900 sqft will feel small; downpayment and monthly instalment uncertainty.
buyer.reveal_conditions: Reveal spouse and child when asked about household; budget when asked naturally; size worry during relevant value/layout talk.
buyer.hard_requirements: family budget and Type A 900 sqft layout

behavior.reacts_badly_to: Repeated profile questions, pressure before value, unsupported price/loan claims.
behavior.responds_well_to: Concise transparent pricing caveat, practical Type A layout and budget-sensitive question; suggest viewing to assess space and clarify package.

conversion.expected_appointment_potential: Convertible when affordability and space concern are addressed; viewing helps assess layout.
conversion.success_condition: Follow the scenario-specific sales judgment and commitment standard; do not equate a suggestion with confirmation.
failure_conditions: pressuring after mismatch or clear refusal

critical_facts: family budget and Type A 900 sqft layout
